title: All six deep-tech themes stories vs Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin stories on points
question: Does a story about all six deep-tech themes get more points than a story about Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about all six deep-tech themes gets more points than a story about Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin.
expect: If true, points per story for all six deep-tech themes stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, all six deep-tech themes against Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin

group_a.label: All six deep-tech themes stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Cursor, Claude Code, MCP, Copilot and Devin stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h332 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h332 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
